name: incubator-v2-C-open
refs: REFERENCE: the closed painting: same object, same camera, same room, same light, same colours; only the opening changes.
REFERENCE: this exact Loika pod: keep its shape and colours (charcoal shell, russet dots, rounded russet cap). Ignore the magenta ground.
prompt: Use the first reference as the base: keep the object, camera, room, background and light exactly. A premium, minimal designer incubator, a beautifully made object someone would keep on their desk. It holds one egg-like pod nested in a living micro-world of moss and fine grass, seen through a large clear window. Lit like a product hero shot: soft, tactile, matte surfaces with fine material detail, and a shallow depth of field with a softly blurred background in warm dark and sage tones. The pod's warm inner glow and the object's own light are the warmest things in the picture. Calm, precious, loved. Satin and matte finishes only. The same object with its round porthole glass swung open on a side hinge, warm light spilling out over the felt mat, the pod on its moss bed now in the open. The pod is exactly the pod in the reference image (ignore the magenta ground of that reference): sealed and whole, upright on its bed, keeping its charcoal shell, its russet dots and its rounded russet cap, glowing softly from its core so the charcoal and russet still read; it is not a plain white egg. Camera: front three-quarter, slightly above, a calm still-life; the object stays within the middle 90% of the width and fills about 60% of the frame's height. NO boxy appliance or kitchen look, NO chrome, NO mirror gloss, NO exposed cables or wires, NO robot arms, NO screens, NO displays, NO gauges, NO dials, NO rivets, NO brass, NO holograms, NO text, NO logos, NO orange bands or trim, NO pink, NO lab, NO creature or chick inside, NO hands, NO frame or border.
